def path_stroke(points, transform=None, speed=.012, note='stroke', cams=['canvas_cam']):
 """Points in exemplar pixels: u,v, press depth in mm. Lengthwise only."""

 send(a,note=note,cams=cams)
 move([*pts[-1,:2],.06],.7,hold=.3,note=note+' lift',cams=cams)

  lo=np.floor(rc.min(0))-5;hi=np.ceil(rc.max(0))+5;sz=(hi-lo).astype(int)+1
  uu,vv=np.meshgrid(np.arange(sz[0]),np.arange(sz[1]));coords=(np.c_[uu.ravel(),vv.ravel()]+lo)@np.linalg.inv(R).T
